items.description: The Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi plant in Tangier is a massive automotive manufacturing facility contributing significantly to Morocco's industrial output.
Founded in 859 AD, the University of Al-Qarawiyyin is recognized as the oldest existing, continually operating educational institution in the world.
The Tinmal Mosque is a 12th-century historical site located in the High Atlas mountains, built to commemorate the founder of the Almohad dynasty.
Sijilmasa was once a prosperous medieval trade city on the northern edge of the Sahara, serving as a hub for gold and salt exchange.
Dar al-Makhzen in Rabat is the official primary residence and workplace of the King of Morocco, serving as the seat of royal power.
The Casablanca Cathedral, or Cathedral of the Sacred Heart, is a former Catholic church known for its unique blend of European and Moroccan architecture.
Dar el Bacha is a stunning example of traditional Moroccan riad architecture, formerly a pasha's palace, now a museum.
Saint-Pierre Cathedral is a prominent Art Deco church located in the heart of Rabat, serving as the seat of the Archdiocese of Rabat.
